versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-pds-intelligent-workspace v0.0.7

- Added support and documentation for PDS挂载盘 (mountapp): install, mount, manage PDS cloud drive as a local disk on Windows/macOS/Linux.
- Updated SKILL.md and references/mountapp.md with mountapp usage scenarios, trigger words, and operational hard rules (including authentication requirements and safeguards for high-risk operations).
- Expanded trigger keywords to include all key mountapp and 挂载盘 phrases, covering mounting, installation, and related terms.
- Clarified when to trigger the skill for both file operations and mountapp-related requests.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md and updated all references to reflect new mountapp-related capabilities.

alibabacloud-pds-intelligent-workspace v0.0.6

- Major skill documentation and structure overhaul for clearer scope and usage guidance.
- Expanded and reorganized user triggers; narrowed activation (skills now trigger strictly for actionable PDS file operations, not for generic knowledge or product questions).
- Added direct references and inline guides for common operations (rename, move, copy, create folder, etc.) and strict handling rules for ambiguous/partial file paths.
- Introduced two new references: file management (rename/move/copy/etc) and resolving partial/relative paths for safer, more accurate file targeting.
- Removed legacy scripts and outdated documentation, simplifying the codebase.
- Explicitly defined hard rules for image editing and similar-search to avoid confusion and ensure correct operation.

- Added support for PDS文件打包下载 (archive/batch download), with new guidance in `references/archive-download.md`.
- Updated trigger logic and documentation: Trigger phrases now cover more Chinese scenarios and general file packaging/batch operations.
- Increased minimum Aliyun CLI version requirement to 3.3.16, and PDS plugin to 0.3.1.
- Improved step-by-step installation/initialization instructions, including AI-Mode controls and updated quick setup commands.
- Reference and internal script updates to support new archive/batch functionality.
- Removed the obsolete skill card documentation file.

- Added support and documentation for PDS file sharing and share links, including new share-link reference.
- Updated skill description and triggers to include file sharing, share link creation, cancellation, searching, and permission control.
- Expanded features list and core concepts to clarify sharing-related terms and usage.
- Removed unused test script (scripts/build_query_test.py) from the codebase.

**Major update: Enforces AI-mode usage, stricter CLI requirements, and new user-agent standards.**

- Requires Aliyun CLI version >= 3.3.3 (previously >= 3.3.1) and PDS plugin >= 0.1.4
- Introduces mandatory enable/disable of AI-mode before and after all CLI-based workflows
- Every CLI command now MUST use a stricter user-agent: `AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-pds-intelligent-workspace`
- Adds step to update plugins with `aliyun plugin update` after installation
- Documentation and command examples updated to reflect new requirements and enforcement steps

- Added image editing and processing features, including scaling, cropping, rotation, segmentation, removal, and watermark operations with save-as to PDS drive.
- Introduced new triggers for "PDS image editing" and "PDS image processing".
- Expanded documentation with `references/image-editing.md` and supporting script for image editing workflow.
- Updated skill description and feature list to reflect image editing support.

Initial release with core PDS cloud drive and mount app capabilities.

- Supports file upload, file download, document analysis, and video analysis on Alibaba Cloud PDS drives.
- Provides commands and guidelines for installing and configuring the PDS mount app plugin.
- Includes strict agent execution guidelines and security controls for handling credentials.
- Reference documentation links for drive, upload, download, search, analysis, and mount app usage.
- Details installation prerequisites and version requirements for Aliyun CLI and PDS plugin.
